title: Fighting for Growth: Labor Scarcity and Technological Progress During the British Industrial Revolution
title_zh: 为增长而战：英国工业革命时期的劳动力稀缺与技术进步
authors: Hans-Joachim Voth, Bruno Caprettini, Alex Trew
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We establish a link between labor scarcity and the adoption of labor-saving technology in industrializing England. During the Napoleonic Wars, more than 10 percent of the male population served in the armed forces. Where recruitment was heavy, more machines economizing on labor were adopted. Naval recruitment, instrumented by warships’ coastal access, provides exogenous variation in labor scarcity and suggests that the link between labor shortages and adoption is causal. Where mechanical skills were abundant, the impact of labor scarcity on adoption appears to be larger.
abstract_zh: 我们建立了劳动力稀缺性与工业化英格兰采用节省劳动力技术之间的联系。在拿破仑战争期间，超过10%的男性人口在武装部队服役。在征兵力度较大的地区，更多节省劳动力的机器被采用。以军舰沿海通道为工具变量的海军征兵，提供了劳动力稀缺性的外生变化，表明劳动力短缺与采用之间存在因果关系。在机械技能丰富的地区，劳动力稀缺性对技术采用的影响似乎更大。

title: Central Bank Communication in Times of Uncertainty: AI-assisted Decoding of Recent Trends in Europe
title_zh: 不确定性时期的央行沟通：欧洲近期趋势的AI辅助解读
authors: Francesca Caselli & Ms. Luisa Charry & Mr. Larry Q Cui & Mr. Pragyan Deb & Allan Dizioli & Alexandra Fotiou & Ben Park & Mr. Sebastian Weber
official: 官方在线 2026-06-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: More frequent large macroeconomic shocks since the global financial crisis have entrenched uncertainty, particularly in Europe. This has increased the premium on central bank communication in guiding expectations and strengthening macroeconomic resilience. European central banks have responded by adapting their communication toolkits and styles. This study provides a systematic assessment of recent central bank communication across advanced and emerging European economies, combining a survey of institutional communication frameworks with novel text-miningbased indicators on monetary policy guidance in these economies over 2009-2025. While communication toolkits are broadly similar, their intensity and transparency differ markedly, with central banks in advanced economies making greater use of forward-looking tools. Central banks in both groups respond primarily to inflation uncertainty. However, communication strategies diverge, as central banks in advanced economies increasingly shift toward forward-looking language, whereas those in emerging markets shift toward more backward-looking communication. These patterns highlight credibility and institutional capacity as key determinants of central bank communication under uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 自全球金融危机以来，频繁发生的宏观经济冲击加剧了不确定性，尤其是在欧洲地区。这提升了央行沟通在引导预期和增强宏观经济韧性方面的价值。欧洲各国央行通过调整其沟通工具包和风格予以应对。本研究结合对机构沟通框架的调查，以及基于文本挖掘技术构建的2009-2025年欧洲发达与新兴经济体货币政策指引新指标，系统评估了近期欧洲各国央行的沟通实践。尽管沟通工具包大致相似，但其使用强度和透明度存在显著差异——发达经济体央行更频繁运用前瞻性工具。两组央行均主要对通胀不确定性作出反应，但沟通策略呈现分化：发达经济体央行日益转向前瞻性表述，而新兴市场央行则更多采用后顾式沟通。这些模式凸显了在不确定性环境下，可信度与制度能力是决定央行沟通策略的关键因素。

title: Germs in the Family: The Short- and Long-Term Consequences of Intrahousehold Disease Spread
title_zh: 家庭中的病菌：家庭内部疾病传播的短期与长期后果
authors: N. Meltem Daysal, Hui Ding, Maya Rossin-Slater, Hannes Schwandt
abstract: Preschool-aged children get sick frequently and spread disease to other family members. Despite the universality of this experience, there is limited causal evidence on the magnitudes and consequences of these externalities, especially for infant siblings with developing immune systems and brains. We show in Danish administrative data that during infancy, younger siblings have two to three times higher hospitalization rates for respiratory conditions than older siblings. We combine birth order and within-municipality variation in respiratory disease prevalence among young children, finding lasting differential impacts of early-life respiratory disease exposure on younger siblings' earnings, educational attainment, chronic respiratory health, and mental health-related outcomes. (JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31)
abstract_zh: 学龄前儿童易患疾病，并会将疾病传染给其他家庭成员。尽管这一经历具有普遍性，但关于这些外部性的程度和后果的因果证据仍然有限，尤其是对于免疫系统和大脑正在发育的婴儿同胞而言。我们利用丹麦行政数据发现，在婴儿期，弟弟妹妹因呼吸系统疾病的住院率是哥哥姐姐的两到三倍。我们结合出生顺序与学龄前儿童呼吸系统疾病患病率的市内差异，发现早期呼吸系统疾病暴露对弟弟妹妹的收入、教育程度、慢性呼吸系统健康及心理健康相关结果产生了持久的差异化影响。（JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31）

title: Dynamic complementarity between noncognitive and cognitive skills: evidence from adolescent development in India
title_zh: 非认知技能与认知技能之间的动态互补性：来自印度青少年发展的证据
authors: Vanshika Chaudhary, Ajay Sharma
abstract: Using longitudinal Young Lives data from Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, India, we examine the effect of noncognitive skills on cognitive abilities at the onset of adolescence and later adolescence, and address endogeneity by using siblings’ noncognitive traits and primary caregiver well-being as imperfectly excluded instruments for the focal child’s noncognitive abilities. Our results suggest that agency improves mathematical ability at the onset of adolescence, indicating a sensitive period of development. No similar effect on language abilities at the same stage indicates domain-specificity of agency effects. Self-efficacy has no effect on cognitive outcomes at either stage. We are unable to reject the null that agency and self-efficacy have no effect on cognitive abilities in later adolescence. Agency effects are concentrated among boys, consistent with theories of gender-specific socialization.
abstract_zh: 利用印度安得拉邦和特伦甘纳邦的纵向青年数据，我们考察了非认知技能对青春期初期及后期认知能力的影响，并通过将兄弟姐妹的非认知特征及主要照料者福祉作为焦点儿童非认知能力的不完全排除工具变量来处理内生性问题。研究结果表明，自主性在青春期初期能提升数学能力，这表明存在一个敏感发展期。同一阶段未发现对语言能力有类似影响，说明自主性效应具有领域特异性。自我效能感在两个阶段均未对认知结果产生显著影响。我们无法拒绝自主性与自我效能感对青春期后期认知能力无影响的零假设。自主性效应集中于男孩群体，这与性别社会化理论一致。

title: How Should Central Banks Respond to Commodity Price Shocks? Optimal Monetary and Exchange Rate Frameworks for Commodity-Exposed Economies
title_zh: 中央银行应如何应对大宗商品价格冲击？大宗商品暴露经济体的最优货币与汇率框架
authors: Drechsel, Thomas, McLeay, Michael, Tenreyro, Silvana, Turri, Enrico D.
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We show that the optimal monetary policy and exchange rate framework depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions may vary with the commodity cycle, and we compute the welfare-optimal policy in the presence of price and wage rigidities. Stabilizing domestic prices is welfare-optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But for economies that use commodities as inputs in production, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ the direct and indirect effects of commodity shocks on domestic prices; this contrasts with some earlier findings and policy practice (which only ‘looks through’ the direct effect). Exchange-rate pegs increase welfare for commodity importers because they stabilize wages and employment, though it is not a robustly optimal policy. In emerging and developing economies, where financial conditions are more tied to the commodity cycle, trade-offs are starker and implementing the optimal policy may be challenging, since it requires enough credibility to keep inflation expectations anchored amidst greater volatility in some nominal variables.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，最优货币政策与汇率框架的关键取决于经济体的商品敞口。我们构建了一个灵活且易于处理的模型经济体，其中包含商品出口与进口，且国际金融状况可能随商品周期而变化，并在存在价格与工资刚性的情况下计算了福利最优政策。对于商品出口国而言，稳定国内价格是福利最优的，这与标准开放经济政策建议一致。但对于将商品作为生产投入的经济体，最优政策在很大程度上会“忽略”商品冲击对国内价格的直接与间接影响——这与早期的一些发现及政策实践（仅“忽略”直接影响）形成对比。对商品进口国而言，汇率盯住制度能提升福利，因其可稳定工资与就业，但这并非稳健的最优政策。在新兴及发展中经济体，金融状况与商品周期的关联更为紧密，政策权衡更为严峻，实施最优政策可能面临挑战，因为这需要足够的公信力，以便在部分名义变量波动加剧时仍能锚定通胀预期。

title: Prospect-Theory Behavior from Bellman Optimality in MDPs with Catastrophic States
title_zh: 具有灾难状态的MDP中来自贝尔曼最优性的前景理论行为
authors: Chen, Yujiao
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study risk-neutral control in Markov decision processes with an absorbing catastrophic state. Even though rewards are linear and the agent has no utility curvature, probability weighting, or framing dependence, standard Bellman optimality produces three prospect-theory-like signatures: an S-shaped value-function profile (convex near catastrophe, concave in the far field), an endogenous loss-sensitivity coefficient $\lambda^*(S) > 1$, and a reflection-effect policy reversal. Across 495 configurations, the optimal policy plays safe near catastrophe in positive-drift (growth) regimes despite the risky action
abstract_zh: 我们研究具有吸收性灾难状态的马尔可夫决策过程中的风险中性控制。尽管奖励是线性的，且主体没有效用曲率、概率加权或框架依赖，标准贝尔曼最优性仍产生三种类似前景理论的特征：S形价值函数轮廓（在灾难附近凸，在远场凹）、内生的损失敏感系数$\lambda^*(S) > 1$，以及反射效应策略反转。在495种配置中，最优策略在正漂移（增长）机制下于灾难附近采取安全行动，尽管存在风险行动。

title: Financial asset choices in the aftermath of a crisis: evidence from India
title_zh: 危机后金融资产选择：来自印度的证据
authors: Abhai Biju, Sanket Mohapatra
abstract: Previous studies have shown that aggregate shocks shape households’ financial conditions and influence their investment behaviour. However, literature provides mixed evidence on the persistence of household investment behaviour in the aftermath of such shocks. This study utilizes a large panel household dataset from India to analyse the investment choices of households in the aftermath of a nationwide pandemic. Our findings indicate that households that experienced adverse impacts on their financial conditions during the crisis have a 2.2% points higher likelihood of investing in relatively safe assets compared to other households. Importantly, a similar preference for safer assets persists in the post-crisis period for such households. This persistence is primarily driven by households whose financial conditions did not improve in the post-crisis period. We also find that financially-strained households’ preference for safer assets is lower in regions that are better banked. Our baseline results are robust to alternate definitions of safe and risky assets, crisis intensity, financially-strained households, potential selection bias, and placebo tests. Our findings suggest that alleviating financial strain and enhancing access to banking services can mitigate risk-averse behaviour both during a crisis and in the subsequent period.
abstract_zh: 已有研究表明，总体冲击会塑造家庭的财务状况并影响其投资行为。然而，关于此类冲击后家庭投资行为持续性的文献证据并不一致。本研究利用印度大规模家庭面板数据，分析全国性疫情后家庭的投资选择。研究结果显示，在危机期间财务状况受到不利影响的家庭，相较于其他家庭，投资相对安全资产的可能性高出2.2个百分点。重要的是，此类家庭在危机后时期仍持续表现出对安全资产的类似偏好。这种持续性主要由危机后财务状况未改善的家庭驱动。我们还发现，在银行服务更完善的地区，财务紧张家庭对安全资产的偏好较低。我们的基准结果在安全与风险资产的不同定义、危机强度、财务紧张家庭界定、潜在选择偏差及安慰剂检验中均保持稳健。研究结论表明，缓解财务压力并增强银行服务可及性，有助于在危机期间及后续时期降低风险规避行为。

abstract: We examine how social interactions and friendships shape students’ political opinions in a natural experiment at Sciences Po, a leading French university specializing in social and political sciences. The quasi-random assignment of students into short-term integration groups before their academic curriculum reduces political opinion gaps and fosters friendship formation. Using same-group membership as an instrumental variable for friendship, we find that friendship reduces opinion differences by 44 percent of the mean opinion gap. Our evidence supports a homophily-enforced mechanism: Friendships form among initially politically similar students, leading them to join political associations together, reinforcing their similarity. (JEL C93, D72, Z13)

title_zh: 学校选择、学生分类与学业表现
authors: Andrei Munteanu
abstract: This study examines the impact of school choice on academic achievement. I use differences in the number of schools across similar Romanian towns, generating variation in school choice for local students, who compete for seats via test scores. I find that more school choice results in increased sorting of students by admission scores across different schools. Sorting widens achievement gaps between high- and low-admission score students. High-scorers having access to better teachers and peer effects are the primary factors explaining these widening gaps. Last, between-school competition via school choice does not increase average achievement levels.
